name: Gondhoraj-Inspired Clear Black Tea
description: The appeal of Gondhoraj lebu cha is its aroma. Handcrafted with an orthodox whole leaf black tea backbone from the Dooars foothills, infused with sun-dried Bengali Gondhoraj lime peel and fresh lemongrass. Designed for a pristine golden-amber clear cup, either piping hot or chilled over ice. A vibrant homage to the beloved Calcutta street-side Lebu Cha tradition.
ingredients: Single Estate Orthodox Black Tea, Dried Gondhoraj Lime Peel, Lemongrass
tasting_notes: Vibrant kaffir lime zest, lemongrass aroma, and crisp sweet citrus blossom over a clean malt base.
dry_leaf_appearance: Neatly twisted wiry dark brown orthodox whole leaves blended with fragrant sun-dried olive-green Gondhoraj peel ribbons and cut lemongrass.
dry_leaf_aroma: Intensely aromatic citrus zest, lemon verbena, and warm honeyed malt.
liquor_hue_name: Luminous amber-gold with bright citrus highlights
liquor_clarity: Brilliant sparkling clarity with zero haze
wet_leaf_aroma: Lemony freshness, crushed citrus leaves, and sweet caramelized malt
wet_leaf_oxidation: Even copper-brown orthodox leaf with distinct pale botanical fragments
steep_instructions: Infuse 2.5 g in 200 ml water at 90–92°C for 3 minutes. Strain completely into a warm porcelain cup or glass mug. Enjoy clear without milk; serve hot or pour over ice cubes with a thin slice of fresh lemon.
origin: Dooars Foothills & Nadia, West Bengal, India
verified_origin: Fulbari Works Batched, Dooars & Nadia, West Bengal, India
cultivar: Camellia sinensis var. assamica x Bengal Gondhoraj
estate_story: Grown in the terai-dooars belt where fertile Himalayan alluvium meets the plains, and blended at our Siliguri cupping facility (Works: Fulbari Ghoshpukur Bypass) with hand-sliced, low-temperature sun-dried Gondhoraj lime peels harvested from Nadia orchards. This blend bridges traditional tea garden orthodox production with artisanal Bengal botanical heritage.
seo_description: Authentic Gondhoraj-infused orthodox clear black tea. Crisp Bengal citrus zest, clean malt backbone, zero artificial flavouring. Order online from TeaFloww.

name: Winter Nolen Gur Chai Concept
description: Nolen gur brings a recognisable winter note to Bengali sweets and drinks. This warming specialty chai pairs a brisk, full-bodied Assam CTC granular black tea base with artisanal crystallised date-palm jaggery (patali gur) from Nadia and South 24 Parganas. Deep caramel tones and woodsy molasses aromatics meld seamlessly with boiling whole milk.
ingredients: Assam CTC Black Tea, Low-Moisture Date Palm Jaggery (Nolen Gur)
tasting_notes: Warm molasses, smoky caramel, toasted malt, and deep date-palm sweetness balanced by brisk CTC strength.
dry_leaf_appearance: Dense, uniform chocolate-brown CTC granules blended with pale golden dehydrated date-palm jaggery crystals.
dry_leaf_aroma: Decadent caramel fudge, warm jaggery molasses, and bold earthy malt.
liquor_hue_name: Deep mahogany-russet with molten copper undertones
liquor_clarity: Rich, dense, and opaque when brewed with milk
wet_leaf_aroma: Sweet date syrup, toasted oats, and dark baked malt
steep_instructions: Simmer 3 g in 100 ml boiling water for 2 minutes, then add 100 ml fresh whole milk and bring to a rolling boil. Strain into a clay kulhad or cup. The natural date-palm jaggery provides gentle warmth; adjust sweetener only after tasting.
origin: Upper Assam & Nadia, West Bengal, India
verified_origin: Fulbari Works Batched, Upper Assam & Nadia, India
estate_story: Sourced from prime riverbank loam in Upper Assam for peak briskness, then combined in micro-batches at our Fulbari works with authentic winter date-palm sap jaggery tapped by traditional siuli artisans in Majhdia. Specially dehydrated to preserve aromatic volatile esters while preventing moisture clumping in the tin.
seo_description: Artisanal winter milk chai infused with authentic Bengal date-palm jaggery (nolen gur) and brisk Assam CTC black tea. Order online from TeaFloww.

name: Panch Phoron-Inspired Spiced Black Tea
description: Inspired by the quintessence of Bengali tempering (torka / chhonk), this savory-sweet spiced blend harmonizes whole orthodox black tea leaves with gently cracked whole spices: mouri (sweet fennel), jeera (cumin), kalo jeere (nigella sativa), methi (fenugreek), and shorshe (wild brown mustard). A fascinating, savoury aromatic profile that delivers profound digestive warmth.
ingredients: Assam Orthodox Black Tea, Traditional Panch Phoron Spices (Fennel, Cumin, Nigella, Fenugreek, Mustard)
tasting_notes: Anise and sweet fennel upfront, followed by savory toasted cumin, peppery nigella seed, and a warming nutty finish.
dry_leaf_appearance: Twisted black orthodox leaf intermingled with teardrop nigella seeds, plump green fennel, ribbed cumin, and golden fenugreek facets.
dry_leaf_aroma: Pungent aromatic anise, roasted coriander, peppery cumin, and crisp woody tea.
liquor_hue_name: Bright copper with warm amber iridescence
liquor_clarity: Clear and glistening with subtle essential spice oils
liquor_body: Medium-full with a clean, savoury-spice coat
wet_leaf_aroma: Sweet fennel pastry, cracked black pepper, and earthy toasted seed aroma
wet_leaf_oxidation: Fully fermented whole orthodox black leaf
steep_instructions: Steep 2.5 g in 200 ml water at 95°C for 3.5 minutes. Can be savoured clear to appreciate the nuanced savoury notes, or simmered with milk and a pinch of rock salt for an authentic rural torka chai.
origin: Golaghat, Assam & Siliguri Spicery, West Bengal, India
verified_origin: Fulbari Works Batched, Golaghat & Siliguri, India
estate_story: Developed in our Siliguri cupping lab as a tribute to the quintessential spice blend of the eastern Gangetic delta. Selected orthodox leaf from Golaghat provides a firm tannic spine capable of holding its own against the complex, sweet-pungent essential oils of freshly cracked spice seeds.
seo_title: Panch Phoron Spiced Black Tea | TeaFloww
seo_description: Distinctive Bengal artisanal black tea tempered with sweet fennel, nigella, cumin, mustard, and fenugreek. Order online from TeaFloww.

name: Kolkata Meetha Paan-Inspired Tea
description: Recreating the romantic ritual of post-dinner Meetha Paan in College Street and Esplanade. Robust black tea leaves are layered with fragrant Lucknowi saunf (sweet candied fennel), hand-picked Indian damask rose petals (gulab patti), and cooling organic spearmint. A dessert-like, aromatic cup that cleanses the palate and uplifts the senses.
ingredients: Assam Black Tea, Saunf (Fennel Seed), Dried Damask Rose Petals, Peppermint Leaf
tasting_notes: Sweet candied fennel, floral damask rose, cool peppermint breeze, and mellow cocoa-malt undertones.
dry_leaf_appearance: Glossy dark brown tea leaves accented with vibrant crimson rose petal slivers, emerald mint flake, and miniature sugar-dusted fennel seeds.
dry_leaf_aroma: Heavenly rose petal confection (gulkand), sweet licorice, and icy mint.
liquor_clarity: Exceptionally bright with natural ruby tint
liquor_body: Smooth, silky, and cooling on the throat
wet_leaf_aroma: Freshly cut roses, menthol coolness, and sweet fennel infusion
wet_leaf_oxidation: Co-fermented black leaf with dried botanical inclusion
steep_instructions: Infuse 2.5 g in 200 ml freshly boiled water (90–92°C) for 3 minutes. Strain and pour into clear glassware. Outstanding served iced with fresh mint or warm after rich festive meals.
verified_origin: Fulbari Works Batched, Assam & Kannauj Rose Gardens, India
cultivar: Assam Clonal TV1 with Indian Damask Rosa
estate_story: Designed to evoke the joyous street corner 'paan dokan' culture of Bengal. We combine a mellow, low-astringency orthodox tea from Assam with organically cultivated Damask roses steam-conditioned in Kannauj and roasted Lucknowi fennel seeds, formulated at our Fulbari works.
seo_title: Kolkata Meetha Paan Inspired Tea | TeaFloww
seo_description: Sweet dessert tea inspired by Calcutta Meetha Paan with fragrant damask rose petals, sweet fennel, and cooling mint. Order online from TeaFloww.

name: Everyday Strong Milk Chai
description: The quintessential morning booster for serious milk-tea drinkers. A master blend of heavy-bodied, hard-fired CTC black tea grains sourced from the south bank of the Brahmaputra River. Engineered specifically to punch through milk, providing deep colour within seconds and delivering an invigorating, tannic briskness with zero bitterness.
tasting_notes: Deep roasted malt, rich cocoa husk, brisk muscular astringency, and comforting toasted grain notes.
dry_leaf_appearance: Extremely uniform, dense, spherical, pitch-black granular pellets with a hard, glossy finish.
dry_leaf_aroma: Intensely pungent, freshly baked biscuits, warm molasses, and dark forest loam.
liquor_hue_name: Inky dark chestnut liquor that blooms into golden apricot when milk is added
liquor_clarity: Deep and viscous liquor with high solid extraction
liquor_body: Heavy, viscous, muscular, and exceptionally brisk
wet_leaf_aroma: Strong pungent tea extract, warm toast, and roasted barley
steep_instructions: Bring 120 ml water and 80 ml full-cream milk to a rolling boil. Add 3 g (1 heaped teaspoon) of CTC tea. Simmer on medium flame for 3–4 minutes until a deep golden hue forms. Add sugar to taste, strain, and serve hot.
verified_origin: Single District Certified, Dibrugarh, Assam, India
cultivar: Camellia sinensis var. assamica (Wild Assamica Clones)
estate_story: Sourced directly from premier second flush CTC gardens along the Brahmaputra in Dibrugarh, renowned worldwide for their thick, heavy liquors. Processed in five-stage rotorvane and triplex CTC machines, then vacuum-packed at our Siliguri depot to lock in briskness before distribution.
seo_description: Extra strong kadak Assam CTC black tea crafted for rich, malty morning milk chai. Unmatched colour and briskness. Order online from TeaFloww.

name: Elaichi Milk Chai
description: India’s beloved royal comfort tea. High-elevation Idukki green cardamom pods (Elettaria cardamomum) are crushed whole—seeds and husks—and blended into robust Assam CTC tea granules. The sweet, cooling, camphorous perfume of freshly opened cardamom pods perfectly balances the bold, malty strength of Assam black tea.
ingredients: Assam CTC Black Tea, Crushed Green Cardamom (Choti Elaichi)
tasting_notes: Sweet piney green cardamom, refreshing floral camphor, rich baked malt, and creamy spiced finish.
dry_leaf_appearance: Dark brown CTC granular pellets speckled generously with crushed lime-green cardamom hulls and glossy black cardamom seeds.
dry_leaf_aroma: Uplifting eucalyptus-cardamom fragrance, warm baking spices, and dark toasted leaf.
liquor_hue_name: Rich copper-amber turning velvety terracotta with milk
liquor_clarity: Bright and full-toned with natural cardamom essential oils floating on surface
wet_leaf_aroma: Sweet crushed cardamom pod, spicy pine notes, and hot malted milk
wet_leaf_oxidation: Fully fermented CTC black tea with crushed spice
steep_instructions: Boil 100 ml water and 100 ml milk together. Add 3 g Elaichi Chai. Simmer for 3 minutes to allow the essential cardamom oils to infuse into the milk fats. Strain into cups and serve steaming hot.
verified_origin: Fulbari Works Batched, Upper Assam & Western Ghats, India
cultivar: TV1 Clonal Tea x Malabar Cardamom Clone
estate_story: Formulated using bold 8mm Mysore-variety green cardamom pods from the misty slopes of Idukki, freshly cracked within 48 hours of blending at our Fulbari facility. Paired with high-density Borbam CTC tea to ensure the cardamom fragrance endures through high boiling without fading.
seo_description: Authentic Elaichi Milk Chai blended with real crushed green cardamom pods and bold Assam CTC tea. Pure spice, zero artificial aroma. Order from TeaFloww.

name: Ginger Milk Chai
description: The definitive Ayurvedic and rainy-day brew. Spicy Himalayan sun-dried ginger root (Zingiber officinale) sourced from the foothills of Kalimpong and Sikkim is coarse-ground and paired with brisk Dooars and Assam CTC black tea. Delivers an invigorating ginger bite in the throat followed by soothing, deep warmth.
ingredients: Assam CTC Black Tea, Sun-Dried Himalayan Ginger (Adrak)
tasting_notes: Fiery zesty ginger root, pungent woody spice, bold malty backbone, and clean soothing peppery finish.
dry_leaf_appearance: Deep ebony-brown CTC tea pearls blended with tan, fiber-rich granules of dried mountain ginger root.
dry_leaf_aroma: Sharp invigorating ginger zest, peppery warmth, and caramelized sugar.
liquor_hue_name: Deep terracotta-brown that turns into creamy golden mustard with milk
liquor_clarity: Rich and dense with micro-particulate ginger sediment
wet_leaf_aroma: Fresh cut ginger pungency, hot peppery broth, and strong malt
wet_leaf_oxidation: Hard-fired black tea granules with dried ginger root
steep_instructions: Combine 120 ml water and 80 ml milk in a saucepan. Bring to boil, add 3 g of Ginger Chai, and boil vigorously for 3 minutes. Sweeten with raw cane sugar or honey, strain, and serve piping hot.
origin: Dooars & Kalimpong Foothills, West Bengal, India
verified_origin: Fulbari Works Batched, Dooars & Kalimpong Foothills, India
estate: Binnaguri Tea Garden & Pedong Ginger Cooperatives
estate_story: Sourced right at our doorstep in North Bengal. Mountain ginger from smallholder organic farms around Pedong and Kalimpong is sun-dried and cracked at our Fulbari works, then blended with CTC black tea from nearby Binnaguri gardens. Freshly packed to preserve high gingerol and shogaol potency.
seo_description: Invigorating Himalayan ginger chai made with sun-dried Kalimpong adrak root and bold Assam CTC black tea. Soothing and warming. Order online from TeaFloww.

name: Balanced Masala Milk Chai
description: The gold standard of Indian spice craft. A masterfully balanced chai featuring seven whole culinary spices blended with heavy-liquoring Assam CTC tea. Formulated to ensure no single spice overpowers the cup: the floral warmth of cardamom, ginger heat, sweet cinnamon woodiness, clove depth, cooling fennel, and black pepper briskness create a harmonious, warming symphony.
ingredients: Assam CTC Black Tea, Green Cardamom, Dried Ginger, Cinnamon, Clove, Fennel, Black Pepper
tasting_notes: Warm cinnamon bark, aromatic clove, pungent ginger, fragrant green cardamom, sweet fennel, and a tingly black pepper finish.
dry_leaf_appearance: High-sheen CTC tea granules interspersed with visible cinnamon chips, crushed green cardamom husks, whole clove heads, cracked black peppercorns, and dried ginger shreds.
dry_leaf_aroma: Festive baking spices, mulled wine aroma, hot sweet cinnamon, and rich Assam malt.
liquor_hue_name: Deep spiced burgundy-chestnut turning rich caramel-cream with milk
liquor_clarity: Robust and velvety with essential spice oil iridescence
wet_leaf_aroma: Spiced holiday pastry, hot clove, fresh cardamom, and sweet cooked tea leaf
wet_leaf_oxidation: 100% oxidised CTC black tea with whole roasted spices
steep_instructions: Add 3 g tea to 100 ml boiling water and 100 ml milk. Boil gently on medium flame for 3–4 minutes until the aroma fills the room. Add raw sugar or jaggery, strain through a fine mesh, and serve hot.
verified_origin: Fulbari Works Batched, Upper Assam & Malabar Spicery, India
cultivar: Assamica Clonal Blend x Malabar Culinary Spices
estate_story: Crafted through months of tasting trials at our Siliguri cupping lab. We calibrate the spice ratios to the natural lipid profile of whole dairy milk, ensuring the essential oils of high-grade Tellicherry black pepper, Ceylon cinnamon, and Zanzibar cloves emulsify smoothly into the tea liquor.
seo_description: Perfectly balanced 7-spice Masala Milk Chai blended with whole spices and kadak Assam CTC tea. Authentic, aromatic, never artificial. Order from TeaFloww.

name: Classic Orthodox Black Tea
description: An unadorned, pure whole-leaf black tea for discerning connoisseurs. Sourced from high-elevation south-facing slopes, the leaves are gently rolled in traditional batten rollers to preserve cellular integrity and long, unbroken leaf wires with golden tips. Offers a sophisticated, layered cup showcasing true terroir without the need for milk or sugar.
ingredients: 100% Single Estate Whole Leaf Orthodox Black Tea
tasting_notes: Ripe stone fruit, muscatel grape, wild wildflower honey, toasted walnut, and crisp mineral astringency.
dry_leaf_appearance: Elegant, well-twisted dark wiry whole leaves generously strewn with silvery-golden pubescent tip buds.
dry_leaf_grade: FTGFOP1 (Finest Tippy Golden Flowery Orange Pekoe 1)
dry_leaf_aroma: Dried apricots, honeyed orchid, dry timber, and cocoa bean.
liquor_hue_name: Glowing golden amber with luminous topaz rim
wet_leaf_aroma: Sweet stewed plums, floral nectar, and warm brioche
steep_instructions: Measure 2.5 g into a warmed teapot. Pour 200 ml water at 90–92°C. Infuse for 3.5 minutes. Pour off the liquor completely. Refills easily for 2–3 successive infusions with evolving sweet notes.
verified_origin: Single Estate Certified, Mirik Valley, Darjeeling, India
cultivar: Pure Camellia sinensis var. sinensis (Old Chinary Bushes)
estate_story: Harvested from hundred-year-old Chinary bushes rooted in high-altitude sub-Himalayan gneiss soil. The steep mountain slopes and sudden alpine mists stress the tea bushes, concentrating delicate muscatel terpenes and natural sugars in the young leaf.
seo_description: Single-estate whole-leaf orthodox Darjeeling black tea with golden tips and natural muscatel honey notes. Connoisseur grade. Order online from TeaFloww.

name: Breakfast CTC Black Tea
description: The definitive morning breakfast companion. Crafted from select clonal gardens in the fertile south bank of Upper Assam during peak second flush. These uniform granular pellets yield a rapid, deeply coloured mahogany brew with a brisk, clean astringency that cuts through a hearty breakfast and awakens the senses.
ingredients: 100% Premium Assam CTC Granular Black Tea
tasting_notes: Toasted sourdough, bittersweet dark cocoa, intense malt, and invigorating tannic snap.
dry_leaf_appearance: Extremely neat, spherical, jet-black CTC granules with hard, bright exterior.
dry_leaf_aroma: Warm roasted grains, bitter chocolate, and sweet molasses.
wet_leaf_aroma: Rich toasted cereal, roasted chicory, and warm earthy malt
steep_instructions: Steep 2.5 g in 200 ml boiling water (98–100°C) for 3 minutes. Perfect as a brisk black breakfast cup, or add a generous dash of cold milk for a classic British breakfast style.
verified_origin: Single Origin Certified, Upper Assam, India
estate_story: Sourced exclusively from prime South Bank tea estates where deep alluvial loam, high monsoon rainfall, and tropical humidity create optimal conditions for robust polyphenolic concentration. Screened to ensure zero dust and minimal fibre.
seo_description: Pure unblended Upper Assam breakfast CTC black tea. Heavy malt, cocoa notes, and invigorating morning briskness. Buy online from TeaFloww.

name: Everyday Green Leaf Tea
description: An antioxidant-rich, pan-fired Himalayan whole-leaf green tea. Non-fermented to lock in vital polyphenols (EGCG) and vibrant chlorophyll. Unlike bitter commodity green teas, this whole leaf brew offers a smooth, sweet vegetal profile with delicate nutty undertones and absolutely zero grassiness or astringent burn.
tasting_notes: Sweet snow pea, steamed edamame, toasted rice, and fresh spring floral sweetness with zero harshness.
dry_leaf_appearance: Slender, gently twisted sage-green whole leaves with occasional silver downy tips.
dry_leaf_aroma: Fresh cut lawn, toasted pumpkin seeds, and sweet clover.
liquor_hue_name: Pale shimmering jade-citron with green-gold luminescence
liquor_body: Light-medium, silky smooth, and soft on the palate
wet_leaf_aroma: Freshly steamed greens, sweet bamboo shoots, and marine freshness
steep_instructions: Cool freshly boiled water to 80°C (allow 3 minutes off boil). Steep 2 g in 200 ml for 2.5 minutes. Strain completely. Never use boiling water to avoid scorching the tender green leaves.
verified_origin: High Foothills Sourced, Kangra & Terai, India
estate: Palampur Green Gardens & Terai High Reserves
cultivar: Camellia sinensis var. sinensis (Himalayan Clonal Green)
estate_story: Harvested in the cool morning dew of early spring. Within three hours of plucking, the leaves are gently tumbled in high-heat roasting woks to deactivate the polyphenol oxidase enzyme, locking in the natural antioxidants, vibrant color, and sweet amino acids (L-theanine).
seo_description: Smooth, non-bitter whole-leaf Himalayan green tea rich in antioxidants. Sweet nutty notes and vibrant jade liquor. Order online from TeaFloww.

name: Gentle White Tea Leaf
description: The pinnacle of tea delicacy. Plucked exclusively at first dawn from high-altitude Darjeeling tea slopes before the morning mist lifts. Composed of tender unopened silver needle buds and young unfurled leaves, naturally withered in ambient mountain breeze and solar-dried with zero rolling or mechanical bruising.
ingredients: 100% High-Elevation Himalayan White Tea Leaf (Silver Tips & Two Leaves)
tasting_notes: Delicate white orchid, sweet honeydew melon, raw almond, tender white peach, and lingering mountain air freshness.
dry_leaf_appearance: Downy, velvety silvery-green needle buds covered in plush white pubescence alongside soft sage-colored leaves.
dry_leaf_aroma: Dried wildflowers, honeydew melon rind, sweet hay, and honey.
liquor_hue_name: Very pale champagne-primrose with platinum glints
liquor_clarity: Sparkling clear, glowing with suspended silver trichomes
liquor_body: Ultra-light, ethereal, velvety, and naturally sweet
wet_leaf_aroma: Fresh cucumber, white lilies, and sweet meadow dew
steep_instructions: Infuse 2 g in 200 ml warm water (80–82°C) for 4 minutes in a glass teapot. Watch the downy silver tips dance upright as they hydrate. Re-infuses up to 4 times, each steep revealing sweeter honeyed nuances.
origin: Kurseong Valley, Darjeeling, West Bengal, India
verified_origin: Single Valley Organic, Kurseong, Darjeeling, India
estate_story: Sourced from legendary Kurseong south-facing terraces above 5,000 feet. Plucked only during a 10-day window in early March by master pluckers who touch only the stem to avoid bruising the delicate trichome-laden silver tips.
seo_title: Gentle White Tea Leaf (Silver Needle) | TeaFloww
seo_description: Rare high-altitude Darjeeling white tea with silver tips. Subtle white orchid, honeydew melon, zero bitterness. Ultra-pure craftsmanship from TeaFloww.

name: Classic Clear Black Tea
description: A quintessential afternoon clear tea. Selected from high-grown Darjeeling summer harvests for its translucent topaz hue, crisp refreshing acidity, and absence of cloudiness when served over ice or enjoyed plain in fine china. A bright, uplifting cup that highlights the pristine pure mountain spring essence.
tasting_notes: Crisp red apple, muscatel grape, sweet cedarwood, and a clean, refreshing mineral finish.
dry_leaf_appearance: Wiry, tightly twisted dark brown whole leaves with hints of olive green and bronze tips.
dry_leaf_aroma: Fresh wood shavings, red fruit jam, and dried marigold.
liquor_hue_name: Radiant crystalline amber with topaz shimmer
liquor_clarity: 100% brilliant diamond clarity, never clouds even when cold
liquor_body: Light to medium, crisp, and refreshing
wet_leaf_aroma: Ripe grapes, floral nectar, and fresh forest bark
steep_instructions: Steep 2.5 g in 200 ml water at 90°C for 3 minutes. Pour through a strainer. Enjoy immediately clear without milk, or chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour and pour over clear ice cubes.
origin: Darjeeling Foothills & Rungmook, West Bengal, India
verified_origin: Single District Certified, Darjeeling, West Bengal, India
estate_story: Sourced from eastern Darjeeling slopes overlooking the Teesta valley. The sharp diurnal temperature swings encourage slow leaf maturation, resulting in minimal sediment and exceptional crystalline liquor stability.
seo_description: Crystal-clear whole-leaf Darjeeling black tea. Crisp muscatel notes, brilliant amber clarity, never clouds when iced. Order online from TeaFloww.

name: Ginger Lemon Clear Tea
description: The timeless cure-all tonic reimagined as a gourmet clear tea. Whole-leaf orthodox tea from the Dooars is blended with dehydrated citrus lemon peel from Assam and dried ginger shards from Sikkim. A brisk, golden cup that balances invigorating ginger heat with the tangy brightness of real lemon zest.
ingredients: Orthodox Black Tea, Sun-Dried Lemon Peel, Himalayan Ginger
tasting_notes: Bright lemon zest, warming peppery ginger, golden honey, and a clean, crisp tea finish.
dry_leaf_appearance: Well-twisted dark brown orthodox leaves mixed with curls of sun-dried yellow-gold lemon peel and coarse ginger nibs.
dry_leaf_aroma: Pungent lemon curd, fresh ginger oil, and dry forest timber.
liquor_hue_name: Glowing sunny amber with golden-yellow rim
liquor_clarity: Sparkling clear with slight natural citrus oil sheen
wet_leaf_aroma: Freshly squeezed lemon juice, warm grated ginger, and sweet tea
wet_leaf_oxidation: Fermented orthodox black tea with unoxidized botanicals
steep_instructions: Steep 2.5 g in 200 ml water at 90–92°C for 3 minutes. Strain into a cup. Add a teaspoon of raw wildflower honey if desired. For iced tea, double the dose, steep for 4 minutes, and pour over a tall glass packed with ice.
verified_origin: Fulbari Works Batched, Dooars & Sikkim, India
cultivar: Camellia sinensis var. assamica x Citrus limon
estate_story: Hand-batched at our Siliguri processing works. Lemons from heritage home orchards in the Sikkim border hills are washed, zest-peeled, and dehydrated at low temperatures (42°C) to preserve essential citrus limonene oils before blending with ginger and estate black tea.
seo_description: Invigorating clear tea crafted with real sun-dried lemon peel, spicy mountain ginger, and orthodox whole leaf black tea. Order from TeaFloww.

name: Mint Green Clear Tea
description: An intensely refreshing Himalayan green tea invigorated with sun-dried spearmint leaves (Mentha spicata). Crafted in the tradition of Moroccan mint but using pure whole-leaf Himalayan green tea, this blend provides a soothing, digestive-friendly cooling sensation on the palate that revitalizes mind and body.
ingredients: Whole Leaf Green Tea, Dried Spearmint Leaf
tasting_notes: Cool spearmint, sweet menthol breeze, crisp green melon, and a delicate sweet vegetal tea finish.
dry_leaf_appearance: Emerald green rolled tea leaves intermingled with coarse crinkled jade-green spearmint foliage.
dry_leaf_aroma: Crisp crushed garden mint, menthol crystals, and fresh green hay.
liquor_hue_name: Luminous chartreuse green with soft golden highlights
wet_leaf_aroma: Fresh mint garden after rain, sweet grassy meadow
wet_leaf_oxidation: 0% unoxidized green leaf with solar-dried mint
steep_instructions: Use 2 g for 200 ml water at 80°C. Steep for 2.5 minutes. Strain and enjoy hot, or let cool and serve over ice with a cucumber ribbon and a sprig of fresh mint.
verified_origin: Fulbari Works Batched, Kangra & Terai, India
cultivar: Himalayan Green Clonal x Mentha spicata
estate_story: Made using highland spearmint cultivated in the pristine air of the Kangra foothills, gently dried without artificial heat to keep the menthol glands intact. Paired with sweet, low-astringency whole green tea leaves from our regional gardens.
seo_description: Pure Himalayan whole-leaf green tea infused with real cooling spearmint leaves. Refreshing hot or cold. Buy online from TeaFloww.

name: Rose Hibiscus Iced Black Tea
description: A visually stunning, ruby-crimson botanical iced tea. Deep malted black tea leaves are harmonized with fragrant sun-dried Kashmiri Damask rose petals and tart Egyptian-variety hibiscus calyces (Hibiscus sabdariffa). Delivers a mouthwatering, tangy-sweet berry and floral profile that quenches deep summer thirst.
ingredients: Assam CTC Black Tea, Dried Kashmiri Rose Petals, Hibiscus Flowers
tasting_notes: Tangy cranberry-hibiscus, fragrant sweet rosewater, pomegranate tartness, and a rounded malt spine.
dry_leaf_appearance: Deep black CTC grains brilliantly contrasted with rich deep magenta hibiscus petals and delicate pink Kashmiri rose flakes.
dry_leaf_aroma: Floral rose garden, sour cherry, dried cranberries, and warm tea.
wet_leaf_aroma: Stewed berry compote, sweet rose nectar, and warm Assam tea
wet_leaf_oxidation: 100% oxidised black tea with dried botanical calyces
steep_instructions: Infuse 2.5 g in 200 ml water at 92°C for 3.5 minutes. Strain. Watch the liquor turn into a dramatic deep ruby red. Serve hot or pour over ice with a slice of orange and a splash of sparkling water for an artisan spritzer.
verified_origin: Fulbari Works Batched, Assam & Kashmir Valley, India
cultivar: Camellia sinensis x Kashmiri Rosa damascena
estate_story: Developed specifically for modern cold-brew and iced tea appreciation. Hand-blended at our Fulbari works in Siliguri, marrying whole organic hibiscus blossoms with genuine Kashmiri rose petals sourced from the renowned floral fields of Pampore.
seo_title: Rose Hibiscus Iced Black Tea | TeaFloww
seo_description: Ruby-red artisan iced black tea infused with real Kashmiri Damask rose petals and tart hibiscus. Refreshing botanical spritzer. Order from TeaFloww.
